name: Sanara MedTech Inc.
summary: Sanara MedTech Inc., a medical technology company, develops, markets, and distributes surgical solutions to physicians, hospitals, clinics, and post-acute care settings in the United States. The company offers CellerateRX Surgical, a medical hydrolysate of Type I bovine collagen indicated for the management of surgical, traumatic, and partial and full-thickness wounds, as well as first and second-degree burns.
